The rationale also treats the specification of scenarios as "implementation details," which conflates the target of the question with the method of how to apply the action.

Also, the rationale says "the authors should address this performance question in the paper" — this is an inference. That part is fine (implicit action). But then it claims concrete implementation — that's the flawed step.
